_comment: Cookbooks listed under 'hidden' stay in the repository and are built, but are not public: every page is unlisted (no landing card, no overview group, no reading path, no readiness-map link, no search or sitemap entry, a noindex tag and a banner), and the folder cookbook-files/<id>/ is removed from the build. A direct link still opens the pages for reviewers. The checker fails when a visible cookbook links into a hidden one. See 'Visibility' in cookbook/authoring/index.md.
_comment_indexed: Cookbooks listed under 'indexed' have cleared review: their pages are in the sitemap and carry no noindex tag. Every other visible cookbook is a working draft: its pages open normally and are listed on the site, but carry a noindex tag and stay out of the sitemap, and every chapter shows the draft banner with the version and date from website/src/content/cookbooks.js.
